test_docstring_options: test pybind11 docstring options to verify function signatures and custom docstrings are generated correctly
test_disable_function_signatures: test that disabling function signatures removes docstrings from pybind11 bound functions
test_enable_function_signatures: test that enabling function signatures adds typed signatures to pybind11 bound function docstrings
test_disable_user_defined_docstrings: test that disabling user-defined docstrings suppresses custom docstrings on pybind11 bound functions
test_enum_docstring_options: test pybind11 enum docstring options to verify member listings and enum docstring generation
